scope: 32 retained synthetic development/audit cases; not held-out, real-source or human gold
candidate: active vibe-frame-v2: typed structural form with layout before dimensions; retained source-faithful manual

manual_fidelity_issues.anger: Adds disappointment/dissatisfaction as an inferred meaning of fury; not an independently supplied feeling.
manual_fidelity_issues.football: Adds supporters praising the impact on performance, not supplied by the source.
manual_fidelity_issues.nfl: Adds fans questioning future prospects, not supplied by the source.
manual_fidelity_issues.other: Adds own-team performance as the reason for delight; source gives no reason.
manual_fidelity_issues.conditional-support: Expressed relief if the appeal succeeds drops the explicit future will-feel qualification.
manual_fidelity_issues.past-only: Calls a six-year-old victory recent and adds an upcoming season.
manual_fidelity_issues.reporter-tone: Invents a September 28 release date from the publication clock and says price was undisclosed although the source says the article gave a price.
manual_fidelity_issues.scores-in-source: Invents an event date from the publication clock and assigns a gender to Sam.

control_findings: Alphabetically sorted form fields produced oversized invented scenes in both old/compact manuals on cheer and schedule. Ordered fields preserved brief supplied observations in those same controls.
The full ordered-form replay still failed paragraph, fidelity and abstention gates. Two successful controls do not establish general reliability.
Nullable-body schema control returned body:null; transport permits abstention. Tested scope and form-clock instruction variants did not solve the product gate and were discarded.
